SELECT (((('ufs1:'::text || length("Ref Borrower")) || ':'::text) || "Ref Borrower") || ':'::text) || to_char("Due Date"::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text) AS "Row ID",
    "Ref Borrower",
    "Due Date",
    sum("Amount Remaining") AS "Total Charge",
    "As Of Date"
   FROM oltp_upcoming_charge_events_v1
  WHERE "Borrower Due Date Rank" >= 1 AND "Borrower Due Date Rank" <= 5 AND "Due Date" <= "Horizon End"
  GROUP BY "Ref Borrower", "Due Date", "As Of Date";
